tags.name: ds-slideshow
tags.description: Root container for a dotslide presentation. Manages navigation state, resize handling, and hash routing.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Internal width of the slides in pixels

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Internal height of the slides in pixels

tags.name: ds-slide
tags.description: Individual slide within a slideshow. Automatically determines its index via DOM queries.

tags.name: ds-step
tags.description: Progressive disclosure within a slide. Content is visible only between 'from' and 'to' steps.

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: First step where this content is visible (inclusive, 1-based)

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: Last step where this content is visible (inclusive, 1-based)

tags.name: ds-section
tags.description: Hierarchical section marker for navigation. Creates section hierarchy for widgets.

tags.name: ds-keyboard-handler
tags.description: Keyboard navigation handler. Maps arrow keys, PageUp/Down, Home/End to navigation actions.

tags.name: ds-button
tags.description: Navigation button. Wraps children in a button element and triggers navigation action on click.

tags.name: ds-overlay
tags.description: Positioning utility for overlays. Positions children relative to the slideshow container.

tags.name: ds-slide-controls
tags.description: Composite control element. Renders prev/next buttons in a bottom-left overlay.

tags.name: ds-progress
tags.description: Progress indicator. Shows slide progress as fraction, percentage, or bar.

attributes.name: data-within
attributes.description: Show progress within a specific section level

tags.name: ds-current-slide
tags.description: Displays current slide number (1-based).

attributes.name: data-within
attributes.description: Show position within a specific section level

tags.name: ds-total-slides
tags.description: Displays total number of slides.

attributes.name: data-within
attributes.description: Show total within a specific section level

tags.name: ds-current-section
tags.description: Displays current section information.

tags.name: ds-loader
tags.description: Loading overlay. Shows progress bar while resources load.

tags.name: ds-flex
tags.description: Flexbox layout container.

tags.name: ds-item
tags.description: Flex item wrapper. Use with ds-flex.

tags.name: ds-list
tags.description: List container. Supports ordered and unordered modes.

tags.name: ds-list-item
tags.description: List item. Use with ds-list.

tags.name: ds-image
tags.description: Image wrapper with resource registration. Wrap an element.

tags.name: ds-video
tags.description: Video wrapper with slide-visibility playback control. Wrap a <video> element.

tags.name: ds-counter
tags.description: Counter element. Registers a counter with the slideshow context.

attributes.name: data-id
attributes.description: Optional ID for referencing this counter

tags.name: ds-reference
tags.description: Reference element. Displays the value of a counter by ID.

attributes.name: data-id
attributes.description: ID of the counter to reference
